---
title: "Conditional predictions"
subtitle: "Experiment design"
---

The conditional experiment predicts twelve monthly burned fractions given observed
target-period environmental covariates and fire history available at each origin.
Annual land-cover and interpolated population/built-area values are supplied
retrospectively. This experiment does not forecast those covariates or estimate
causal effects of changing them.

Both model classes receive a fresh search. PCA retains 0–39 components from the
39 dynamic predictors; 12 terrain, land-cover, and human predictors bypass PCA.
Unreduced dynamic predictors are also eligible. Seasonal order ranges from 0 to 6.
The neural encoder's lookback ranges from 12 to 48 months in three-month increments.
Link functions remain fixed.

Parameters fit on training data through May 2018. Test data through July 2020 select
configurations and checkpoints by negative log likelihood. Both representatives
are fixed before assessment on the later validation period, through December 2024.
That period was examined in previous work and is not an untouched holdout.

The initial configurations balance representations, harmonic orders, and model
sizes. Every neural lookback appears at least twice. Searches and interrupted fits
are resumable; a twelve-hour session can finish before the experiment is complete.

Results will use the same matched-request scores, residual diagnostics, occurrence
curves, training space-time autocorrelation, and validation maps as the forecast
analysis. No fitted conditional results are presented until both representatives
and their provenance have passed the experiment checks.
